title: Shortest Palindrome by Prepending
description: Given a string `s`, add the fewest characters possible to its front so that the entire result is a palindrome. Added characters must come from `s` in reverse order; characters already in `s` cannot be rearranged. Input: lowercase string `s`. Output: the shortest resulting palindrome.
hints: Keep track of the smallest state needed to continue matching or comparing characters.
Test empty, one-character, repeated-character, and boundary inputs.
